summary: VSee Health, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a securities purchase agreement with institutional investor Labrys, issuing a $336,000 unsecured convertible promissory note (including $36,000 original issue discount). The note carries a 12% one-time interest charge, matures June 30, 2027, and is convertible into common stock under specified conditions. Labrys may require application of up to 50% of certain cash proceeds to repay the note. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation, as it involves neither a change in control, strategic transaction, nor extraordinary corporate event.
